name: Haitoku no Hinomiya-sou
original_name: 背徳の妃ノ宮荘-肉欲を孕むご近女さん-
source:
An old apartment building — Himenomiya Manor

The residents there are burdened with circumstances they cannot reveal to anyone.
Each goes about their daily lives while harboring secrets they cannot share with anyone.

But their growing carnal desires gradually begin to distort their everyday lives.
[MTL from [url=http://www.terra.dti.ne.jp/~f-rui/works/myworks/hinomiyasou/hinomiyasou.html]product page[/url]]
translation:
一栋老旧的公寓楼——妃之宫庄。

住在这里的房客们，各自都背负着绝不能向外人启齿的隐情。
每个人都将无法与任何人分享的秘密深埋心底，过着平静的日常生活。

然而她们体内日益膨胀的肉欲，渐渐开始扭曲原本平淡的日常。
[译自[url=http://www.terra.dti.ne.jp/~f-rui/works/myworks/hinomiyasou/hinomiyasou.html]作品主页[/url]]
